form_fields.name: monitor_url
form_fields.label: URL
form_fields.description: 填写 Management 根地址，例如 http://127.0.0.1:15672，不要带 /api/queues。
form_fields.description_en: Enter the Management root, for example http://127.0.0.1:15672. Do not include /api/queues.
form_fields.guide_short: 填写 Management 根地址，例如 http://127.0.0.1:15672，不要带 /api/queues。与 AMQP 5672 不同，默认 15672；需先 rabbitmq-plugins enable rabbitmq_management。保存时去掉末尾斜杠并折叠重复斜杠。若填写了 host:port 之后的路径会提示警告。
form_fields.guide_short_en: Enter the Management root, for example http://127.0.0.1:15672. Do not include /api/queues. This is port 15672 by default, not AMQP 5672; enable rabbitmq_management first. On save, trailing slashes are stripped and duplicate slashes are collapsed. A path after host:port shows a warning.

rules.message: 请填写 Management 根地址（例如 http://127.0.0.1:15672），不要带路径，尤其不要写 /api/queues。
rules.message_en: Enter the Management root (for example http://127.0.0.1:15672) with no path. Do not include /api/queues.

form_fields.name: username
form_fields.label: 用户名
form_fields.description: 用于访问接口的用户名
form_fields.guide_short: Management 账号，建议 rabbitmqctl set_user_tags <username> monitoring 授予只读标签；guest 默认仅本地登录，远程采集请新建账号。
form_fields.guide_short_en: Management account with the monitoring tag and access to the required API resources. The guest user is local-only by default, so create a dedicated account for remote collection.

form_fields.name: ENV_PASSWORD
form_fields.label: 密码
form_fields.guide_short: Management 密码，通过 Authorization 头发送，含 @ : / # 等特殊字符无需转义；不要带入首尾空格。
form_fields.guide_short_en: Management password sent in the Authorization header. Characters such as @, :, /, or # require no URL escaping; omit leading or trailing spaces.

form_fields.name: interval
form_fields.label: 间隔
form_fields.description: 监控数据的采集时间间隔（单位：秒）
form_fields.guide_short: Telegraf inputs.rabbitmq 采集周期，单位秒，默认 60；建议 ≥30 避免反复调用 Management API。
form_fields.guide_short_en: Telegraf inputs.rabbitmq collection interval in seconds; the default is 60. Use at least 30 seconds to avoid excessive Management API calls.

form_fields.name: collect_queues
form_fields.label: 采集队列
form_fields.description: 是否采集队列级指标。默认关闭，不请求 /api/queues。
form_fields.guide_short: 默认只采集 overview 与 node。开启后才会请求 /api/queues。名称过滤仍会先拉全表，只减少入库，不能减轻 Management 拉取压力；停止该压力的唯一办法是关闭本开关。
form_fields.guide_short_en: Default collection is overview and node only. Enabling this hits /api/queues. Name filters still fetch the full queue table and only reduce stored series; they do not reduce Management fetch pressure. Turning this off is the only way to stop that pressure.
form_fields.description_en: Collect queue-level metrics. Off by default so /api/queues is not called.

form_fields.name: queue_name_include
form_fields.label: 队列包含
form_fields.guide_short: 开启后必须填包含规则，不填不能保存，避免全量拉取 /api/queues。名称过滤仍会先拉全表 /api/queues，只减少入库；要减轻 Management API 压力请关闭「采集队列」。
form_fields.guide_short_en: When Collect Queues is on, include rules are required. Empty values cannot be saved, to avoid fetching all of /api/queues. Name filters still fetch the full /api/queues table and only reduce stored series; turn Collect Queues off to stop Management API pressure.

rules.message: 开启后必须填包含规则，不填不能保存，避免全量拉取 /api/queues
rules.message_en: When Collect Queues is on, include rules are required. Empty values cannot be saved, to avoid fetching all of /api/queues.

form_fields.description_en: Avoid * — it still fetches the full /api/queues table.

form_fields.name: queue_name_exclude
form_fields.label: 队列排除
form_fields.description: 队列名 glob 排除列表，可选。
form_fields.guide_short: Telegraf queue_name_exclude，可选。排除同样不减少 /api/queues 全表拉取。
form_fields.guide_short_en: Optional Telegraf queue_name_exclude. Excludes still fetch the full /api/queues table.

form_fields.name: client_timeout
form_fields.label: 超时
form_fields.description: Management API 客户端超时（秒），采集队列时建议 15–30。
form_fields.guide_short: Telegraf client_timeout。开启队列采集后全表 /api/queues 较慢，默认 20 秒，可调 15–30。
form_fields.guide_short_en: Telegraf client_timeout. Queue collection fetches the full /api/queues table, so use 15–30 seconds; the default is 20.
form_fields.description_en: Management API client timeout in seconds. Use 15–30 when collecting queues.
